# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 93 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 50 | Coptic

---

## Saying 93

Jesus said: "Do not give what is holy to dogs, lest they throw it upon the dung heap. Do not throw pearls to swine, lest they make it become mud."

---

**Translator's Notes (EMET):**

- Parallel to Matthew 7:6; Thomas version expands with two outcomes: dogs throw it on the dung heap; swine turn it to mud
- **ⲡⲉⲧⲟⲩⲁⲁⲃ** / *petouaab*: "what is holy" — the consecrated, sacred thing
- The two outcomes are unique to Thomas: "throw it upon the dung heap" (dogs) and "make it become mud" (swine)
- The "dung heap" (*koprōn*) is a stronger image than Matthew's implicit waste
- "Make it become mud" — the pearl dissolved into worthless matter
- The esoteric warning: sacred teaching should not be given to those who will desecrate it
